title: Bradley C
content: I was 7 years old in 1981 when I flipped over the handlebars on my bicycle and landed on my head. I instantly left my body and floated above myself without a physical form. I felt no pain or fear. For what seemed like a long time, I saw myself upside down at the point of impact, frozen in time. Then I saw myself lying on the sidewalk, bleeding, while the other kids panicked about what to do. I felt at peace as everything unfolded, simply observing from above. Then my father came home from work. He sprang into action, picked me up, and put me into our Volkswagen van. Once he placed me inside, my out-of-body experience ended. If my father hadn’t come home at that moment, I would have died, I’m sure. When I got home from the hospital about two weeks later, I asked the neighborhood kids who were there to describe exactly what they saw and where they stood. I questioned each of them, curious how I could have witnessed everything from above. I didn’t know what to make of it, and the kids seemed skeptical of my story, so I left it alone. I never talked to anyone about it. It was my own knowledge. Since that event, I’ve been unable to join a religion. I believe there is something special and spiritual beyond life. Just be good to others and enjoy the time we have here.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Accident, Direct head injury, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness, I think the same
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, My physical body was frozen in time at the point of impact, and I could watch it from above.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Seemed more peaceful during the experience.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Do not know, This event has left me spiritual without a specific religion.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, Based on the accounts of the witnesses, I felt certain that I hovered over the scene and watched it unfold.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Uncertain, I was so young, I didn't really know what my values and beliefs were yet.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, It was like one of life's big questions had been revealed.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain, I didn't come across any information, but I felt absolute certainty that there is existence after life.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain, There have been several times when I have felt a strong intuition that turned out to be true.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, You just know
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, What I saw happened
